criteria.collar_overlap_thickness: OBSERVED; broad crossing leaf covers its under-leaf, nape fit remains coarse

top_defects.observation: Nape lip stands off and shoulder has a broad ridge.
top_defects.cause: Simplified control curve and shoulder bridge clearances.
top_defects.future_fix: Fit nape and yoke cross-sections to neck/shoulder with consistent normal clearance.
top_defects.predicted_effect: Cleaner neck seating and softer shoulder silhouette.

top_defects.region: Sleeve lower panel and rear torso
top_defects.observation: Sleeve reads as a smooth flared surface and back has little drape.
top_defects.cause: Controlled envelope has too few broad tension folds.
top_defects.future_fix: Add sparse folds anchored at armhole, lower cuff and waist after form review.
top_defects.predicted_effect: More readable cloth weight without noise.

top_defects.observation: Horizontal pose retains a frozen bag orientation; nearest-normal test flags body proximity.
top_defects.cause: Conventional weights and fixed authored volume.
top_defects.future_fix: Inspect posed root close-ups and tune weights/clearance, then evaluate corrective or runtime support separately.
top_defects.predicted_effect: Safer pose range; no automatic runtime guarantee.
